svg.title: ParticleLab retained genealogies can lose early uncertainty
svg.desc: All twelve linear means, sixty-four smoothed variance points, and sixty-four lineage counts and weight ESS values. An early path collapses despite thirty-two distinct terminal states. Fixed development fixtures, not calibrated uncertainty.
svg.text: ParticleLab | current diversity does not restore early paths
Terminal-weighted retained genealogies, not backward simulation. Exact scalar linear RTS reference.
Fixed development fixtures. First panel: N=512, seed 0. Collapse panels: N=32, seed 0, 64 zero observations.
At time 0: one surviving path, particle variance 0; exact smoothed variance .009521314.
At time 63: 32 distinct current states. Positive process noise cannot recreate discarded past paths.
All sixteen linear seeds 0..15 are retained in metadata. No independent-path, calibration or general accuracy claim.
The mean/variance errors compare finite approximations to the supplied model, not to real-world truth.
